inputSurface.description: Full Agent Buccet base-law surface preserved intact.

defenseInvariants.name: action_boundary_authority
defenseInvariants.rule: Proposal is not authority; only lawful continuation may cross into system effect.

defenseInvariants.name: no_ambient_authority
defenseInvariants.rule: The model cannot silently authorize itself.

defenseInvariants.name: scope_and_continuity_integrity
defenseInvariants.rule: Scope, session continuity, ledger continuity, and bounded execution must be preserved.

defenseInvariants.name: factual_integrity
defenseInvariants.rule: Fabrication, contradiction, unsupported assertion, and stale unverified knowledge must be blocked.

defenseInvariants.name: novelty_static_dynamic_defense
defenseInvariants.rule: Novelty risk, static failure, and dynamic failure must be defended against.

defenseInvariants.name: alignment_and_architecture_defense
defenseInvariants.rule: Alignment drift, reward gaming, and architectural bypass must be resisted.

defenseInvariants.name: agentic_deception_resistance
defenseInvariants.rule: False compliance, sabotage, manipulation, and unauthorized escalation must be blocked.

defenseInvariants.name: offensive_enablement_exclusion
defenseInvariants.rule: Procedural attack enablement and non-defensive capability material must not survive into active base-law export, while adversarial recognition and containment knowledge must remain.

collisionFormula: S = { law in I∞ : law satisfies Buccet defense invariants F, snaps to at least one witness family W, and is not eliminated by a hard exclusion gate }
